text: Entry Requirements 1. Be non-Chinese citizens with a vaild ordinary-type passport, and in good health both mentally and physically. No criminal record. 2. Applicants are generally between 18 and 55 years old (Before June 30 of the admission year). Guardian's Letter of Guarantee is required for applicants under 18 years old. 3. Applicants should have a high school diploma or an equivalent qualification. 4. Zero-based; According to the results of the Chinese proficiency test, students are graded and divided into classes.
